name: example-rbac
description: A simple yet realistic RBAC system using JWT, SQLite, and Express. Built to demonstrate permission-based access in REST APIs — ideal for learning and extending in real-world projects.

scripts.start:e2e:frontend: cd packages/frontend && ng build --configuration=production && cd dist/example-rbac-frontend/browser && http-server -a localhost --port 8443 -s -c-1 --ssl --cert ../../../../../ssl/server.cert --key ../../../../../ssl/server.key -P https://localhost:8443?
scripts.start:prod:frontend: cd packages/frontend && ng build --configuration=production && cd dist/example-rbac-frontend/browser && http-server -a localhost --port 8443 --ssl --cert ../../../../../ssl/server.cert --key ../../../../../ssl/server.key -P https://localhost:8443?
scripts.e2e: dotenvx run -f .env.e2e -- start-server-and-test start:e2e https://localhost:8443 "cypress run --project packages/frontend-e2e --headless"
